items.desc_now: DeepSeek Harness plugins for the failures nobody catches: auto-format, generated-file guard, .env drift detection, and a typecheck gate that runs before the agent says it's done. Four gaps the 13k-plugin ecosystem hasn't filled.
items.desc_prev: Six quality-of-life plugins for DeepSeek Harness: /rewind workspace undo, desktop notifications, auto-format, live git context, secret redaction, and a done-means-green verify gate. No build step.
